name: Momokawa Honoka
source: The protagonist's childhood friend and half Japanese. Cheerful and can get along with everyone, but the drawback is that the way she talk isn't pleasant. After finding out that the protagonist moved to a different town, she immediately chased after him, so everyone knows about her love for the him. She can be pretty frank about her thoughts. In order to get the protagonist to notice her, even what she wears is to pander to his likings. Her cat ears and tail is the only fake among the girls in Masshigura.
